segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour sign-on as a dog; Case discusses restart habits and technical prep.

segments.title: Rundown & Crumb Song Planning
segments.notes: Case outlines the night: Amongst the Web, Hate Sock, and a Crumb backup-vocal song with DJ C4; Crumb is absent.

segments.title: AI Slop Video Showcase (VO3/Veo)
segments.notes: Case watches viewer-submitted AI-generated videos of himself and Pepito; marvels at improving realism.

segments.title: News Desk with Jeff Ripple
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple reads Supreme Court birthright citizenship ruling, Senate war-powers vote, Trump-Canada trade termination, and stock market rally.

segments.title: Trailer Watch: Monster Island, Star People, Garten of Banban 8, Night of the Comet
segments.notes: Case and Trent (parole officer) watch and rate trailers; Trent's chaotic energy derails the segment.

segments.title: Hate Sock on Birthright Citizenship
segments.notes: Hate Sock delivers a hate-fueled monologue against the Supreme Court; reveals he is Sammy Seven Elbows in sock form.

segments.title: Amongst the Web with Hype Train
segments.notes: Hype Train hijacks the segment, describes hell's new 'rainbow traffic' scrunchie system, watches churning butter and organ videos.

segments.title: Scott Steiner Workout Infomercial Marathon
segments.notes: Case and Scrum watch the full Scott Steiner 'Big Poppa Pump' workout video; debate its eroticism and rating.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon News Block
segments.notes: News stowaway Peter Gibbon forces his way on air; reads mile-high club, sperm freezing, Bezos wedding, poop cruise, SpaceX crane collapse, and ChatGPT bleach-vinegar stories.

segments.title: Therapy Roulette & Coach McGurk Firing
segments.notes: Case cycles through fake therapists; Coach McGurk appears, argues with Munch, gets fired by Munch after defending Crum.

segments.title: Debate: Worst Mario Party Mini-Game
segments.notes: Munch picks 'Multi-Face Bowser Vine'; Crum picks 'Sonic Racers'; Coach McGurk interrupts; Munch fires him again.

segments.title: Trip Bradstein Street Interviews
segments.notes: Trip interviews park denizens: box man, Crumb Stashio Crumbfish, sound guy, Francis Sick Nerf, cat man, Balthazar, Big Bobby Bagelsby, Big Poppa Pump, Kendall.

segments.title: AI-Generated 'Gooning' Country Song
segments.notes: DJ C4 writes and generates a vulgar country song about gooning and rats using Suno/Refusion; plays final version over YouTube beat.

segments.title: Raid & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Case raids BYTT (Butt Gamers); promises real song next week.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the broadcast, managed technical chaos, hosted News, Amongst the Web, and DJ C4 segments.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open as a dog; operated switcher; managed music bans on Peter.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Delivered the news block covering Supreme Court, Senate, Trump-Canada trade, and markets.

characters.name: Hate Sock
characters.notes: recurring puppet. Revealed identity as Sammy Seven Elbows; threatened self-immolation in Supreme Court justices' mouths.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical/cultural correspondent. Hijacked Amongst the Web; described hell's rainbow traffic; watched butter-churning and organ videos.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Invaded news block; admitted to OnlyFans subscriptions on company card; banned from music for three weeks.

characters.name: Coach McGurk
characters.notes: physical therapist. Appeared in Therapy and Debate; defended Crum; fired by Munch after revealing male-squirting sex-ed past.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Crum on Mario Party mini-games; fired Coach McGurk; claimed 99% victory forecast over Crum.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Present as decomposed corpse; picked Sonic Racers; blamed for Munch's legal expenses and gorilla murder.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted street interviews with 10-minute cooldown on !trip command; encountered parade of park characters.

characters.name: DJ C4
characters.notes: musical producer. Wrote and AI-generated a vulgar country song about gooning and rats; played final version over YouTube beat.

characters.name: Kendall
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly appeared on Trip's street segment; told Trip to let Case leave for DJ bit.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News delivered a chaotic Friday broadcast: Jeff Ripple read the Supreme Court's birthright citizenship punt and Senate war-powers failure, Hate Sock outed himself as Sammy Seven Elbows while threatening judicial self-immolation, Hype Train described hell's new scrunchie-based traffic system, Peter Gibbon hijacked the news block to confess company-card OnlyFans spending, Coach McGurk was fired twice in one night by Munch, and DJ C4 closed the show by AI-generating a vulgar country anthem about gooning rats before raiding the Butt Gamers.
